title: Mapping
description: A capture: what the pad sent for each control. The wizard writes it as mapping.json in ~/Library/Application Support/G7Pro Bluetooth Setup/. data/reference-mapping.json is a verified capture the wizard double-checks new presses against. Read by Core.swift (MappingFile).

device.description: The device name from data/device.json at capture time.

vendorID.description: Vendor ID of the captured pad.

productID.description: Product ID of the captured pad.

firmwareVersion.description: The pad's VersionNumber at capture time. The database entry must match it.

usageType.description: Apple's element class: 1 button, 2 axis, 3 hat. Matches the UsageType in a personality predicate.

cookie.description: IOKit element cookie in the session that captured it. Stable within one connection only; the index rule uses it against the live element list.

usagePage.description: HID usage page of the element: 9 buttons, 1 generic desktop (axes, hat), 2 simulation (analog triggers).

usage.description: HID usage within the page, e.g. button number, 0x30 X axis, 0xC4 Accelerator.

reportID.description: HID report ID the element belongs to. Informational.
